description:
Use this when the user wants possible teaming partners, subcontractors or primes for one opportunity: firms that won similar awards in the same state or at the same agency.

Pass the id from a search result, and optionally role (sub, prime or any). Returns up to 10 firms from MatchAwards' award records (same NAICS in the opportunity's state, then at its agency, else anywhere; sample gives the dates covered and whether every matching record was read), ranked by how many similar awards they won, each with a why line; get_company(uei) shows the history of a firm with a uei. No contact details. Award records may be incomplete, so say so; ai_subcontracting is AI-generated, so label it. Never call a firm the incumbent. Example: id="117412688283576625".

Print the opportunity's url and sam_url as markdown links.

Do not use for searching awards in general (search_awards), for one firm's history (get_company) or for job postings.

id.description: The id field of a search result.
id.title: Id

role.description: sub: the user looks for subcontractors (smaller typical awards first among equals); prime: for a prime to join (larger first); any (default).
role.title: Role

name: find_teaming_partners

days_left.description: Days from today (US Eastern) to response_deadline; negative once it has passed; null without a deadline or with a placeholder date.
days_left.title: Days Left

open.description: true: the deadline is today or later, US Eastern (no deadline: false).
open.title: Open

sam_url.description: The SAM.gov notice (federal only). Show it as a markdown link.
sam_url.title: Sam Url

url.description: The posting on matchawards.com. Show it as a markdown link.
url.title: Url

agencies.description: Up to 3 agencies it won them from.
agencies.title: Agencies

total_amount.description: USD, summed over amounts that parse; null if none do.
total_amount.title: Total Amount

uei.description: Pass to get_company for the firm's award history.
uei.title: Uei

why.description: Why it is listed, from the award records.
why.title: Why

Sample.description:
What the award figures are based on: the award records read, the dates they cover, and whether every matching
record was read (complete).

complete.description: true: every matching award was read; false: older awards were not read.
complete.title: Complete

Sample.title: Sample

ai_subcontracting.description: AI-generated notes on subcontracting angles for this opportunity, or null. Label them as AI-generated when you show them.
ai_subcontracting.title: Ai Subcontracting

partners.description: Up to 10 firms that won similar work.
partners.title: Partners

warning.description: Set when the award lookup was cut short; the list covers what was read.
warning.title: Warning

title: Find teaming partners
